Appearance:
MRS VD NANAVATI(1206) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR RUTVIJ OZA, APP for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 RULE SERVED(64) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 08/09/2018
ORAL ORDER 1.

This Criminal Appeal has been preferred under Section 378(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 against the judgment and order of acquittal dated 12.09.2011 rendered by learned Additional Sessions Judge, 15th Court, Ahmedabad in Criminal Appeal No. 228 of 2010 under the provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
2. This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
3. Mr. Rutvij Oza, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / R/CR.A/533/2012 ORDER settlement pursis, which is taken on record.
The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by APP Shri Rutvij Oza, Mr. Amit R. Patel, Food Safety Officer on behalf of the appellant and learned advocate for the respondent no.1.

sentences.text: Mr. Amit R. Patel, Food Safety Officer from the office of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation is present and he states that in absence of learned advocate appearing for the appellant, he has instructions to withdraw this Appeal.
He has further submitted that he is authorized to withdraw this Appeal under the instructions, and therefore, he requested to dispose of this matter.
He has produced an authority letter, which is taken on record.
All the concerned are present in person before this Lok Adalat, and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP and respective learned advocates.

5. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
6. In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.
The respondents No.1 is directed to R/CR.A/533/2012 ORDER pay a sum of Rs. 3,000/- (Rupees Three thousand only) towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties.

Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically and the said amount be transmitted to the concerned Municipal Corporation.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

7. However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,
incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.

(B.N. KARIA, J.) Chairman ksdarji Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation vs Takhatsinh Natvarsinh Rajput on 8 September, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194383744/
